_comment: Allow-list for frozen_check.py (tools-agent, fill ef-r23-regev, 2026-11-18). For each changed EXISTING file (the three facades), the only permitted changes against the base are the listed insertions. An insertion is placed directly after the base line `after` (exact text, must occur exactly once in the base), and its inserted lines are either `lines` (exact) or match `pattern` (a Python regex for the FIRST line; continuation lines must start with two spaces and not with `* `; at most `max_lines` lines in all). kind=import: every line must be an `import` line; kind=bullet: the lines must lie inside the `## Contents` section of the head file. The PublicKey facade (series 3) is given by pattern; replace it by exact `lines` once the lead has fixed the wording. `allowed_paths` are the six paths the fill may touch.
